# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#  bases.entail — whole numbers in any base from 2 to 16
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
#
#  Generated by make_bases.py. Edit the rules there.
#
#  A number is the same number in any base. Each digit of the source is worth a
#  fixed amount in each column of the target, so a conversion is a linear sum
#  followed by carrying. No large number is ever held, so 32 bits fit easily.
#
#    255 in binary is                 11111111
#    255 in hex is                    ff
#    0xff in decimal is               255
#    0b1011 =                         11
#    0o755 in binary is               111101101
#    1011 binary in decimal is        11
#    1203 base 7 in decimal is        444
#    1000 in base 7 is                2626
#
#  Values run from 0 to 4294967295. Anything larger entails nothing.

program bases

const W  = 35    # 32 binary digits, their prefix, and what stands before it
const HW = 9     # tokens of a hexadecimal number: at most 8 digits and an x
const S  = 34    # answer tokens: a blank, 32 digits, the end of the answer
const NT = 21    # columns of the general conversion: base 3 needs 21
const TM = 125   # the largest carry in that conversion
const CM = 100   # the largest carry into a hexadecimal column

# ─── 1. Tokens ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const K_DIGIT = 1
const K_HEXL  = 2     # letters that are all hexadecimal digits
const K_X     = 3
const K_O     = 4
const K_GAP   = 5
const K_BAD   = 6     # a mark that makes the number next to it something else
const K_IN    = 7
const K_NAME  = 8
const K_AL    = 9     # the end of " oct|al"
const K_BASE  = 10
const K_IS    = 11
const K_EQ    = 12
const K_B     = 13    # a hexadecimal digit, and the mark of binary

state val, kind, hl, n0, n1, n2, n3, n4, n5, n6, n7

for d in 0 to 9
    token "{d}" means val = d, kind = K_DIGIT, hl = 1, n0 = d
end
token "o"  means kind = K_O
token " "  means kind = K_GAP
token ".", ",", "-", "_", "/", "$" means kind = K_BAD
token " in", " to" means kind = K_IN
token " binary" means val = 2, kind = K_NAME
token " oct", " octal" means val = 8, kind = K_NAME
token " decimal" means val = 10, kind = K_NAME
token " hex", " hexadecimal" means val = 16, kind = K_NAME
token "al" means kind = K_AL
token " base" means kind = K_BASE
token " is" means kind = K_IS
token " =", "=", ":" means kind = K_EQ

token "xfff" means kind = K_X, hl = 3, n0 = 15, n1 = 15, n2 = 15
token "xffff" means kind = K_X, hl = 4, n0 = 15, n1 = 15, n2 = 15, n3 = 15
token "xffffff" means kind = K_X, hl = 6, n0 = 15, n1 = 15, n2 = 15, n3 = 15, n4 = 15, n5 = 15
token "xffffffff" means kind = K_X, hl = 8, n0 = 15, n1 = 15, n2 = 15, n3 = 15, n4 = 15, n5 = 15, n6 = 15, n7 = 15

# ─── 2. Sight ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

state wv[W + 1], wk[W + 1]
for k in 1 to W
    attend back k
        wv[k] <- val
        wk[k] <- kind
    end
end
state wl[HW + 1], wn[HW + 1][8]
for k in 1 to HW
    attend back k
        wl[k] <- hl
        wn[k][0] <- n0
        wn[k][1] <- n1
        wn[k][2] <- n2
        wn[k][3] <- n3
        wn[k][4] <- n4
        wn[k][5] <- n5
        wn[k][6] <- n6
        wn[k][7] <- n7
    end
end

let kk[0] = kind
let vv[0] = val
let ll[0] = hl
let nn[0][0] = n0
let nn[0][1] = n1
let nn[0][2] = n2
let nn[0][3] = n3
let nn[0][4] = n4
let nn[0][5] = n5
let nn[0][6] = n6
let nn[0][7] = n7
for k in 1 to W
    let kk[k] = wk[k]
    let vv[k] = wv[k]
end
for k in 1 to HW
    let ll[k] = wl[k]
    for t in 0 to 7
        let nn[k][t] = wn[k][t]
    end
end

state dg[W + 1], gp[W + 1], bad[W + 1], zr[W + 1], ans[W + 1], hy[HW + 1]
for k in 0 to W
    entail dg[k] when kk[k] == K_DIGIT
    entail gp[k] when kk[k] == K_GAP
    entail zr[k] when dg[k], vv[k] == 0
    # what cannot stand just before a plain number
    entail bad[k] when kk[k] == K_DIGIT
    entail bad[k] when kk[k] == K_HEXL
    entail bad[k] when kk[k] == K_B
    entail bad[k] when kk[k] == K_X
    entail bad[k] when kk[k] == K_O
    entail bad[k] when kk[k] == K_BAD
    # tokens an answer can hold
    entail ans[k] when kk[k] == K_DIGIT
    entail ans[k] when kk[k] == K_HEXL
    entail ans[k] when kk[k] == K_B
    entail ans[k] when kk[k] == K_GAP
end
for k in 0 to HW
    entail hy[k] when kk[k] == K_DIGIT
    entail hy[k] when kk[k] == K_HEXL
    entail hy[k] when kk[k] == K_B
end

# ─── 3. A number ending at this token ───────────────────────────────────────
#
# run[n]: n digits end here. What stands before them says what they are.

state run[33], plain, pB, pO
for n in 1 to 32
    entail run[n] when (sum i in 0 to n-1 : dg[i]) >= n, not dg[n]
    entail plain when run[n], not bad[n]
    entail pB when run[n], kk[n] == K_B, zr[n+1], not dg[n+2]
    entail pO when run[n], kk[n] == K_O, zr[n+1], not dg[n+2]
end

state mv[32]
for i in 0 to 31
    entail mv[i] = vv[i] when (sum n in i+1 to 32 : run[n]) >= 1
end
let lenv = (sum n in 1 to 32 : n * run[n])

# ov[t]: how many digits reach t, which a number in base t may not hold.
state mg[10][32]
for t in 2 to 9
    for i in 0 to 31
        entail mg[t][i] when mv[i] >= t
    end
    let ov[t] = (sum i in 0 to 31 : mg[t][i])
end

# A hexadecimal number. hx[h]: its x stands h tokens back, with a 0 before it.
state hx[9], pX
entail hx[0] when kk[0] == K_X, zr[1], not dg[2]
for h in 1 to 8
    entail hx[h] when kk[h] == K_X, (sum i in 0 to h-1 : hy[i]) >= h, zr[h+1], not dg[h+2]
end
for h in 0 to 8
    entail pX when hx[h], (sum u in 0 to h : ll[u]) >= 1, (sum u in 0 to h : ll[u]) <= 8
end

# sh[i][s]: the tokens after token i hold s digits, so its own start at column s.
state sh[9][8], tI[9], hv[8]
for i in 0 to 8
    entail tI[i] when (sum h in i to 8 : hx[h]) >= 1
end
for t in 0 to 7
    entail hv[t] = nn[0][t] when tI[0]
end
for i in 1 to 8
    for s in 0 to 7
        entail sh[i][s] when tI[i], (sum u in 0 to i-1 : ll[u]) == s
        for t in 0 to 7 - s
            entail hv[s+t] = nn[i][t] when sh[i][s]
        end
    end
end

# ─── 4. A question, asked at this token ─────────────────────────────────────
#
#     1203 base 7  in  base 12  is
#     └ source     └ e tokens back

state ender, tg[5], Tv
entail ender when kk[0] == K_IS
entail ender when kk[0] == K_EQ
entail tg[1] when ender, kk[1] == K_NAME
entail tg[2] when ender, kk[1] == K_AL, kk[2] == K_NAME
entail tg[3] when ender, dg[1], gp[2], kk[3] == K_BASE
entail tg[4] when ender, dg[1], dg[2], gp[3], kk[4] == K_BASE
entail Tv = vv[1] when tg[1]
entail Tv = vv[2] when tg[2]
entail Tv = vv[1] when tg[3]
entail Tv = 10*vv[2] + vv[1] when tg[4]

state pp[7], bare
for e in 1 to 4
    entail pp[e+2] when tg[e], kk[e+1] == K_IN
end
entail bare when ender, not tg[1], not tg[2], not tg[3], not tg[4]
entail Tv = 10 when bare

# The source's own base, if a word says so.
state wName[7], wB1[7], wB2[7], Bw, worded, ptr[11]
for p in 3 to 6
    entail wName[p] when pp[p], kk[p] == K_NAME
    entail wB1[p] when pp[p], dg[p], gp[p+1], kk[p+2] == K_BASE
    entail wB2[p] when pp[p], dg[p], dg[p+1], gp[p+2], kk[p+3] == K_BASE
    entail Bw = vv[p] when wName[p]
    entail Bw = vv[p] when wB1[p]
    entail Bw = 10*vv[p+1] + vv[p] when wB2[p]
    entail worded when wName[p]
    entail worded when wB1[p]
    entail worded when wB2[p]
    entail ptr[p+1] when wName[p]
    entail ptr[p+3] when wB1[p]
    entail ptr[p+4] when wB2[p]
    entail ptr[p] when pp[p], not wName[p], not wB1[p], not wB2[p]
end
entail ptr[1] when bare

state gm[32], gh[8], gPlain, gPB, gPO, gPX, gL, gOv[10]
attend back by ptr
    for i in 0 to 31
        gm[i] <- mv[i]
    end
    for j in 0 to 7
        gh[j] <- hv[j]
    end
    gPlain <- plain
    gPB <- pB
    gPO <- pO
    gPX <- pX
    gL <- lenv
    for t in 2 to 9
        gOv[t] <- ov[t]
    end
end

# ─── 5. Into hexadecimal columns ────────────────────────────────────────────

state sB[17], sX, fit[17], col[8]
entail sB[10] when gPlain, not worded, not bare
entail sB[2] when gPB, not worded
entail sB[8] when gPO, not worded
entail sX when gPX, not worded
for b in 2 to 16
    entail sB[b] when gPlain, worded, Bw == b
end

def source(B, D)
    if B < 10
        entail fit[B] when sB[B], gL <= D, gOv[B] <= 0
    else
        entail fit[B] when sB[B], gL <= D
    end
    for j in 0 to 7
        entail col[j] = (sum i in 0 to D-1 : (floor(B^i / 16^j) - 16*floor(B^i / 16^(j+1))) * gm[i]) when fit[B]
    end
end
call source(2, 32)
call source(3, 21)
call source(4, 16)
call source(5, 14)
call source(6, 13)
call source(7, 12)
call source(8, 11)
call source(9, 11)
call source(10, 10)
call source(16, 8)
for j in 0 to 7
    entail col[j] = gh[j] when sX
end

let okS = sX + (sum b in 2 to 10 : fit[b]) + fit[16]

state cy[8][CM + 1]
let carry[0] = 0
for j in 0 to 7
    for t in 1 to CM
        entail cy[j][t] when col[j] + carry[j] >= 16*t
    end
    let carry[j+1] = (sum t in 1 to CM : cy[j][t])
    let nib[j] = col[j] + carry[j] - 16*carry[j+1]
end

# ─── 6. Into the target's columns ───────────────────────────────────────────

state isT[17]
for b in 2 to 16
    entail isT[b] when Tv == b, okS >= 1, carry[8] <= 0
end
let live = (sum b in 2 to 16 : isT[b])

# Base 2 is the same columns, cut finer.
state nz[8][16]
for j in 0 to 7
    for v in 0 to 15
        entail nz[j][v] when nib[j] == v
    end
    for t in 0 to 3
        let bit[4*j + t] = (sum v in 0 to 15 : (floor(v / 2^t) - 2*floor(v / 2^(t+1))) * nz[j][v])
    end
end

# Every other base, by one chain of carries. The base is a lane, so a carry
# compares with t times the base, and one chain serves them all.
state tc[NT]
for b in 3 to 15
    for m in 0 to NT - 1
        if b^m < 2^32
            entail tc[m] = (sum j in 0 to 7 : (floor(16^j / b^m) - b*floor(16^j / b^(m+1))) * nib[j]) when isT[b]
        end
    end
end

state th[NT][TM + 1], dv[NT]
let car[0] = 0
for m in 0 to NT - 1
    for t in 1 to TM
        entail th[m][t] when tc[m] + car[m] - t*Tv >= 0
    end
    let car[m+1] = (sum t in 1 to TM : th[m][t])
    for b in 3 to 15
        entail dv[m] = tc[m] + car[m] - b*car[m+1] when isT[b]
    end
end

state res[32]
for m in 0 to 31
    entail res[m] = bit[m] when isT[2]
end
for m in 0 to 7
    entail res[m] = nib[m] when isT[16]
end
for m in 0 to NT - 1
    entail res[m] = dv[m]
end

# ─── 7. The answer, as a sequence of tokens ─────────────────────────────────

const C_BLANK = 17
const C_END   = 18

state top[32]
for k in 1 to 30
    entail top[k] when live >= 1, res[k] >= 1, (sum i in k+1 to 31 : res[i]) <= 0
end
entail top[31] when live >= 1, res[31] >= 1
entail top[0] when live >= 1, (sum i in 1 to 31 : res[i]) <= 0

state code[S]
entail code[0] = C_BLANK when live >= 1
for k in 0 to 31
    for s in 0 to k
        entail code[1+s] = res[k-s] + 1 when top[k]
    end
    entail code[k+2] = C_END when top[k]
end

# ─── 8. Writing it out ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

state anc
entail anc when live >= 1

state wa[S]
for c in 1 to S - 1
    attend back c
        wa[c] <- anc
    end
end

state from[S], slot[S]
entail from[0] when anc
entail slot[0] when anc
for c in 1 to S - 1
    entail from[c] when wa[c], (sum i in 0 to c-1 : ans[i]) >= c
    entail slot[c] when wa[c], (sum i in 0 to c-1 : ans[i]) >= c
end

state seen[S]
attend back by from
    for s in 0 to S-1
        seen[s] <- code[s]
    end
end

state say
for s in 0 to S-1
    entail say = seen[s] when slot[s]
end

state o[19]
for d in 1 to 18
    entail o[d] when say == d
end
for d in 0 to 9
    emit "{d}" when o[d+1]
end
emit "a" when o[11]
emit "b" when o[12]
emit "c" when o[13]
emit "d" when o[14]
emit "e" when o[15]
emit "f" when o[16]
emit " " when o[C_BLANK]
emit end when o[C_END]
